scenes.head: WHAT IS ETHEREUM
scenes.hook: ETHEREUM IS MORE THAN A COIN
scenes.narration: Ethereum is more than a coin. Here is what it really is, in thirty seconds.

scenes.head: THE IDEA
scenes.hook: A PUBLIC COMPUTER ANYONE CAN USE
scenes.narration: Ethereum is a shared network. Developers put programs on it, called smart contracts, and they run exactly as written.

scenes.head: HOW IT WORKS
scenes.hook: VALIDATORS LOCK UP ETH TO SECURE IT
scenes.narration: Instead of mining, validators lock up ether as a deposit to check transactions. Ether also pays the fees.

scenes.head: THE LIMIT
scenes.narration: When many people use it at once, fees can rise. That is one real limitation beginners should know.

scenes.head: WHAT TO DO
scenes.hook: LEARN HOW IT WORKS BEFORE ANYTHING ELSE
scenes.narration: Understand what a coin does before you ever touch it. Knowledge first.
